question.problem:
| $x$ | **$-3$** | **$-1$** | **$1$** | **$3$** | **$5$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-5$ | $-25$ | $5$ | $20$ | $35$ |

The vector of coefficients of the curve $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}x+{\beta }_{2}{x}^{2}$ that best fits the data above can be found using polynomial regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix $X$ in this context?
question.worked_solution:
| $x$ | **$-3$** | **$-1$** | **$1$** | **$3$** | **$5$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-5$ | $-25$ | $5$ | $20$ | $25$ |

The coefficients of the curve 

$$
y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}x+{\beta }_{2}{x}^{2}
$$

that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & (-3)^{2} \\ 1 & -1 & (-1)^{2} \\ 1 & 1 & {1}^{2} \\ 1 & 3 & {3}^{2} \\ 1 & 5 & {5}^{2}\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -25 \\ 5 \\ 20 \\ 35\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
